title: EDI Lens partner rules
description: Rules of one partner's implementation guide, checked by EDI Lens: Validate With Partner Rules.

name.description: Name of the guide, shown in messages and reports.

format.description: The format the rules are written for.

messageTypes.description: Message types the rules apply to, for example ORDERS, 850 or ADT^A01 (ADT alone matches every ADT message). Leave out to check every message.

segmentSelector.description: A segment: NAD, NAD[BY] (first element is BY), NM1[IL|QC], OBX[3.1=2345-7] (element 3, component 1), LIN#2 (the second LIN of the message).

pathSelector.description: A value: SEG-element, SEG-element.component or SEG-element.component.subcomponent, with an optional qualifier in brackets: BGM-1.1, NAD[BY]-2.1, PID-5.1, PID-13(2).1.

id.description: Short id of the rule, shown in front of every violation.

message.description: The sentence shown for a violation. Without it EDI Lens writes one.

messageTypes.description: Limit this rule to some message types.

within.description: Check the rule once per group instead of once per message. A group starts at each segment named here and ends before the next segment with the same id.

until.description: Segment ids that also end a group.

pattern.description: A regular expression. Backreferences, lookarounds and a repeated group that contains a repetition, an optional part or an alternative are refused.

format.description: Date format built from CCYY, YY, MM, DD, hh, mm, ss and separators, for example CCYYMMDD or CCYYMMDDhhmm.

if.description: The condition: a segment is present, a value is filled, or a value equals one of the listed values. "not": true reverses it.

then.description: The rule that must hold when the condition is true.

left.description: A path, count(SEG), sum(PATH) or a number.

right.description: A path, count(SEG), sum(PATH) or a number.

tolerance.description: Largest difference between two numbers that still counts as equal.
